categories.name: cold_menace
categories.title: Cold menace / calculation
categories.when: A powerful, dangerous character stays in control -- threatens, gives orders, or thinks through next steps without raising their voice.
examples: Speak coldly, calculating his next move.
Speak coldly, issuing a curt command.
Speak in a low hiss, seething with menace.

categories.name: fear_panic_horror
categories.title: Fear / panic / horror
categories.when: A character in immediate danger or shock -- a physical fear reaction, not a reflection on it.
examples: Speak in a trembling whisper, choking back a sob.

categories.name: calm_resolve
categories.title: Calm resolve
categories.when: A character has made a decision and speaks firmly, without fear or aggression.
examples: Speak calmly and confidently, everything is decided.
